set.body: Goal: make derived guide placement a measured solver-owned layout instead of hard-coded npc origins and stacking increments. Current evidence: nonPositionGuides still uses fixed origins and fixed legend and colorbar decrements even though LayoutPolicy already carries TextMetrics and the solver reserves the guide region. Acceptance: derive guide row height, title height, label width, inter-guide gaps, and mixed legend plus colorbar stacking from LayoutPolicy using the portable TextMetrics estimator; express placement in the reserved guide viewport with typed overflow errors; remove magic npc spacing constants from derivation; cover long labels, multiple legends, mixed guide kinds, and overflow; preserve deterministic JVM plus Scala.js output and all backend conformance. Platform-specific metrics are an optional later provider, not a prerequisite.
set.title: Graphics: solver-owned legend and colorbar stack layout
